href="#tools-for-automations" class="py-v1/12 hover:text-theme-text-sec block ">Tools for automations</a></li></ul></div></nav><div class="prose prose--block prose--blog col-span-full!"><p>Last month, we launched the <a href="https://cursor.com/blog/marketplace" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Cursor Marketplace</a> to make it easier to connect Cursor to your existing tools and knowledge.</p>
<p>Today, we&#x27;re adding more than 30 new plugins from partners such as Atlassian, Datadog, GitLab, Glean, Hugging Face, monday.com, and PlanetScale. Cursor can now read from, write to, and take actions across more of your stack.</p>
<figure><div class="media-border-container overflow-hidden"><img alt="Over 30 new plugins join the Cursor Marketplace" loading="lazy" width="800" height="450" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" class="media-light transition-opacity duration-[220ms] ease-[var(--ease-out-spring)] will-change-[opacity] opacity-0" style="color:transparent" srcSet="/marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Fblog%2Fmarketplace-36-logos-updated.png&amp;w=828&amp;q=70 1x, /marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Fblog%2Fmarketplace-36-logos-updated.png&amp;w=1920&amp;q=70 2x" src="/marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Fblog%2Fmarketplace-36-logos-updated.png&amp;w=1920&amp;q=70"/><img alt="Over 30 new plugins join the Cursor Marketplace" loading="lazy" width="800" height="450" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" class="media-dark transition-opacity duration-[220ms] ease-[var(--ease-out-spring)] will-change-[opacity] opacity-0" style="color:transparent" srcSet="/marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Fblog%2Fmarketplace-36-logos-dark-updated.png&amp;w=828&amp;q=70 1x, /marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Fblog%2Fmarketplace-36-logos-dark-updated.png&amp;w=1920&amp;q=70 2x" src="/marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Fblog%2Fmarketplace-36-logos-dark-updated.png&amp;w=1920&amp;q=70"/></div></figure>
<p>You can install plugins on the <a href="https://cursor.com/marketplace" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Cursor Marketplace</a>, or build your own and <a href="https://cursor.com/marketplace/publish" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">share them</a> with the community. On Teams and Enterprise plans, Admins can also create <a href="https://cursor.com/docs/plugins#team-marketplaces" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">team marketplaces</a> for distributing and managing private plugins.</p>
<h2 id="agents-that-work-more-independently" class="anchor-heading group "><a href="#agents-that-work-more-independently" class="anchor-link" aria-label="Link to this section"><span class="anchor-icon" aria-hidden="true">#</span></a>Agents that work more independently</h2>
<p>We&#x27;ve found that what matters most for an agent&#x27;s success is access to the right tools and context. Plugins provide that by bundling capabilities like MCPs with skills that instruct the agent on how to use it. Since the initial release of Cursor Marketplace, users have reported that this combination is much more powerful than MCPs on their own.</p>
<p>The plugins we&#x27;re introducing today span the entire development workflow, equipping agents to work more independently. Two broad buckets we&#x27;re particularly excited about are infrastructure and productivity tools.</p>
<h3 id="infrastructure" class="anchor-heading group "><a href="#infrastructure" class="anchor-link" aria-label="Link to this section"><span class="anchor-icon" aria-hidden="true">#</span></a>Infrastructure</h3>
<p>Use natural language to query logs, metrics, traces, and dashboards with the <a href="https://cursor.com/marketplace/datadog" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Datadog plugin</a>.</p>
<figure class="!my-1"><div style="aspect-ratio:1920 / 1080;overflow:hidden"><div class="media-border-container media-controller w-full " style="width:100%;height:100%;background-color:var(--theme-bg-sec, #1a1a1a);background-image:url(https://image.mux.com/eUduxR499QXUAJWQRKMeUeajtj0068wDn00D6mz57g68U/thumbnail.jpg?time=0);background-size:cover;background-position:center"></div></div></figure>
<p>View and manage issues, merge requests, pipelines, and repositories with the <a href="https://cursor.com/marketplace/gitlab" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">GitLab plugin</a>.</p>
<figure class="!my-1"><div style="aspect-ratio:1920 / 1080;overflow:hidden"><div class="media-border-container media-controller w-full " style="width:100%;height:100%;background-color:var(--theme-bg-sec, #1a1a1a);background-image:url(https://image.mux.com/piyyQ7Ikjvu36mBgh6oESyx8skpCkvYoaot4ulBCnJA/thumbnail.jpg?time=0);background-size:cover;background-position:center"></div></div></figure>
<p>Discover and apply schema recommendations, improve query performance, and work with your data in natural language with the <a href="https://cursor.com/marketplace/planetscale" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">PlanetScale plugin</a>.</p>
<figure class="!my-1"><div style="aspect-ratio:1920 / 1080;overflow:hidden"><div class="media-border-container media-controller w-full " style="width:100%;height:100%;background-color:var(--theme-bg-sec, #1a1a1a);background-image:url(https://image.mux.com/7oGVIVrdqRX1gy5jM8dgW7AVLZSPzmx00pu02A7UMpn5g/thumbnail.jpg?time=0);background-size:cover;background-position:center"></div></div></figure>
<h3 id="productivity" class="anchor-heading group "><a href="#productivity" class="anchor-link" aria-label="Link to this section"><span class="anchor-icon" aria-hidden="true">#</span></a>Productivity</h3>
<p>Search and manage issues, generate status reports, and convert specs into backlogs with the <a href="https://cursor.com/marketplace/atlassian" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Atlassian plugin</a>.</p>
<figure class="!my-1"><div style="aspect-ratio:1920 / 1080;overflow:hidden"><div class="media-border-container media-controller w-full " style="width:100%;height:100%;background-color:var(--theme-bg-sec, #1a1a1a);background-image:url(https://image.mux.com/9HFnoAPpJ00cEjpLafCbErhghdbnnod4mV2DhfTHVMeU/thumbnail.jpg?time=0);background-size:cover;background-position:center"></div></div></figure>
<p>Search company knowledge, and find project owners and stakeholders with the <a href="https://cursor.com/marketplace/glean" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Glean plugin</a>.</p>
<figure class="!my-1"><div style="aspect-ratio:1920 / 1080;overflow:hidden"><div class="media-border-container media-controller w-full " style="width:100%;height:100%;background-color:var(--theme-bg-sec, #1a1a1a);background-image:url(https://image.mux.com/MRYGMXjqi02GoEXR6yYbkVfnh7rEAGj4cdxogpUNDXzk/thumbnail.jpg?time=0);background-size:cover;background-position:center"></div></div></figure>
<p>Access and manage project boards and tasks with the <a href="https://cursor.com/marketplace/monday" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">monday.com plugin</a>.</p>
<figure class="!my-1"><div style="aspect-ratio:1920 / 1080;overflow:hidden"><div class="media-border-container media-controller w-full " style="width:100%;height:100%;background-color:var(--theme-bg-sec, #1a1a1a);background-image:url(https://image.mux.com/lAD6cltRvM6iVB02PEutdHdsTqShY01EdWEQGy00194yto/thumbnail.jpg?time=0);background-size:cover;background-position:center"></div></div></figure>
<h2 id="tools-for-automations" class="anchor-heading group "><a href="#tools-for-automations" class="anchor-link" aria-label="Link to this section"><span class="anchor-icon" aria-hidden="true">#</span></a>Tools for automations</h2>
<p>Most plugins contain MCPs that cloud agents can use when kicked off manually or invoked automatically. You can use <a href="https://cursor.com/blog/automations" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Cursor Automations</a> to build always-on agents that run on schedules or are triggered by events. They follow your custom instructions, and can use tools like the Datadog MCP to investigate logs depending on the task they&#x27;re configured to complete.</p>
<p>Try out the new plugins at <a href="https://cursor.com/marketplace" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">cursor.com/marketplace</a>, or learn more in the <a href="https://cursor.com/docs/plugins" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">docs</a>.</p></div><footer class="mt-v2"><p class="type-base"><span class="text-theme-text-sec">Filed under:<!-- --> we launched the <a href="https://cursor.com/blog/marketplace" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Cursor Marketplace</a> to make it easier to connect Cursor to your existing tools and knowledge.</p>
<p>Today, we&#x27;re adding more than 30 new plugins from partners such as Atlassian, Datadog, GitLab, Glean, Hugging Face, monday.com, and PlanetScale. Cursor can now read from, write to, and take actions across more of your stack.</p>
<figure><div class="media-border-container overflow-hidden"><img alt="Over 30 new plugins join the Cursor Marketplace" loading="lazy" width="800" height="450" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" class="media-light transition-opacity duration-[220ms] ease-[var(--ease-out-spring)] will-change-[opacity] opacity-0" style="color:transparent" srcSet="/marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Fblog%2Fmarketplace-36-logos-updated.png&amp;w=828&amp;q=70 1x, /marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Fblog%2Fmarketplace-36-logos-updated.png&amp;w=1920&amp;q=70 2x" src="/marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Fblog%2Fmarketplace-36-logos-updated.png&amp;w=1920&amp;q=70"/><img alt="Over 30 new plugins join the Cursor Marketplace" loading="lazy" width="800" height="450" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" class="media-dark transition-opacity duration-[220ms] ease-[var(--ease-out-spring)] will-change-[opacity] opacity-0" style="color:transparent" srcSet="/marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Fblog%2Fmarketplace-36-logos-dark-updated.png&amp;w=828&amp;q=70 1x, /marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Fblog%2Fmarketplace-36-logos-dark-updated.png&amp;w=1920&amp;q=70 2x" src="/marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Fblog%2Fmarketplace-36-logos-dark-updated.png&amp;w=1920&amp;q=70"/></div></figure>
<p>You can install plugins on the <a href="https://cursor.com/marketplace" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Cursor Marketplace</a>, or build your own and <a href="https://cursor.com/marketplace/publish" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">share them</a> with the community. On Teams and Enterprise plans, Admins can also create <a href="https://cursor.com/docs/plugins#team-marketplaces" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">team marketplaces</a> for distributing and managing private plugins.</p>
<h2 id="agents-that-work-more-independently" class="anchor-heading group "><a href="#agents-that-work-more-independently" class="anchor-link" aria-label="Link to this section"><span class="anchor-icon" aria-hidden="true">#</span></a>Agents that work more independently</h2>
<p>We&#x27;ve found that what matters most for an agent&#x27;s success is access to the right tools and context. Plugins provide that by bundling capabilities like MCPs with skills that instruct the agent on how to use it. Since the initial release of Cursor Marketplace, users have reported that this combination is much more powerful than MCPs on their own.</p>
<p>The plugins we&#x27;re introducing today span the entire development workflow, equipping agents to work more independently. Two broad buckets we&#x27;re particularly excited about are infrastructure and productivity tools.</p>
<h3 id="infrastructure" class="anchor-heading group "><a href="#infrastructure" class="anchor-link" aria-label="Link to this section"><span class="anchor-icon" aria-hidden="true">#</span></a>Infrastructure</h3>
<p>Use natural language to query logs, metrics, traces, and dashboards with the <a href="https://cursor.com/marketplace/datadog" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Datadog plugin</a>.</p>
<figure class="!my-1"><div style="aspect-ratio:1920 / 1080;overflow:hidden"><div class="media-border-container media-controller w-full " style="width:100%;height:100%;background-color:var(--theme-bg-sec, #1a1a1a);background-image:url(https://image.mux.com/eUduxR499QXUAJWQRKMeUeajtj0068wDn00D6mz57g68U/thumbnail.jpg?time=0);background-size:cover;background-position:center"></div></div></figure>
<p>View and manage issues, merge requests, pipelines, and repositories with the <a href="https://cursor.com/marketplace/gitlab" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">GitLab plugin</a>.</p>
<figure class="!my-1"><div style="aspect-ratio:1920 / 1080;overflow:hidden"><div class="media-border-container media-controller w-full " style="width:100%;height:100%;background-color:var(--theme-bg-sec, #1a1a1a);background-image:url(https://image.mux.com/piyyQ7Ikjvu36mBgh6oESyx8skpCkvYoaot4ulBCnJA/thumbnail.jpg?time=0);background-size:cover;background-position:center"></div></div></figure>
<p>Discover and apply schema recommendations, improve query performance, and work with your data in natural language with the <a href="https://cursor.com/marketplace/planetscale" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">PlanetScale plugin</a>.</p>
<figure class="!my-1"><div style="aspect-ratio:1920 / 1080;overflow:hidden"><div class="media-border-container media-controller w-full " style="width:100%;height:100%;background-color:var(--theme-bg-sec, #1a1a1a);background-image:url(https://image.mux.com/7oGVIVrdqRX1gy5jM8dgW7AVLZSPzmx00pu02A7UMpn5g/thumbnail.jpg?time=0);background-size:cover;background-position:center"></div></div></figure>
<h3 id="productivity" class="anchor-heading group "><a href="#productivity" class="anchor-link" aria-label="Link to this section"><span class="anchor-icon" aria-hidden="true">#</span></a>Productivity</h3>
<p>Search and manage issues, generate status reports, and convert specs into backlogs with the <a href="https://cursor.com/marketplace/atlassian" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Atlassian plugin</a>.</p>
<figure class="!my-1"><div style="aspect-ratio:1920 / 1080;overflow:hidden"><div class="media-border-container media-controller w-full " style="width:100%;height:100%;background-color:var(--theme-bg-sec, #1a1a1a);background-image:url(https://image.mux.com/9HFnoAPpJ00cEjpLafCbErhghdbnnod4mV2DhfTHVMeU/thumbnail.jpg?time=0);background-size:cover;background-position:center"></div></div></figure>
<p>Search company knowledge, and find project owners and stakeholders with the <a href="https://cursor.com/marketplace/glean" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Glean plugin</a>.</p>
<figure class="!my-1"><div style="aspect-ratio:1920 / 1080;overflow:hidden"><div class="media-border-container media-controller w-full " style="width:100%;height:100%;background-color:var(--theme-bg-sec, #1a1a1a);background-image:url(https://image.mux.com/MRYGMXjqi02GoEXR6yYbkVfnh7rEAGj4cdxogpUNDXzk/thumbnail.jpg?time=0);background-size:cover;background-position:center"></div></div></figure>
<p>Access and manage project boards and tasks with the <a href="https://cursor.com/marketplace/monday" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">monday.com plugin</a>.</p>
<figure class="!my-1"><div style="aspect-ratio:1920 / 1080;overflow:hidden"><div class="media-border-container media-controller w-full " style="width:100%;height:100%;background-color:var(--theme-bg-sec, #1a1a1a);background-image:url(https://image.mux.com/lAD6cltRvM6iVB02PEutdHdsTqShY01EdWEQGy00194yto/thumbnail.jpg?time=0);background-size:cover;background-position:center"></div></div></figure>
<h2 id="tools-for-automations" class="anchor-heading group "><a href="#tools-for-automations" class="anchor-link" aria-label="Link to this section"><span class="anchor-icon" aria-hidden="true">#</span></a>Tools for automations</h2>
<p>Most plugins contain MCPs that cloud agents can use when kicked off manually or invoked automatically. You can use <a href="https://cursor.com/blog/automations" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Cursor Automations</a> to build always-on agents that run on schedules or are triggered by events. They follow your custom instructions, and can use tools like the Datadog MCP to investigate logs depending on the task they&#x27;re configured to complete.</p>
<p>Try out the new plugins at <a href="https://cursor.com/marketplace" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">cursor.com/marketplace</a>, or learn more in the <a href="https://cursor.com/docs/plugins" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">docs</a>.</p></div><footer class="mt-v2"><p class="type-base"><span class="text-theme-text-sec">Filed under:<!-- -->
